mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sky_user (user_id, username, password_hash, email, phone, avatar, department_id, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{departmentId}, #{enabled})

UPDATE sky_user SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM sky_user u JOIN sky_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sky_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.enabled = TRUE AND r.role_name = 'ADMIN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sky_user_role ur JOIN sky_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.role_name = #{roleName}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sky_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, role_id FROM sky_role WHERE role_name = #{roleName}
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_name FROM sky_role r JOIN sky_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_name FROM sky_permission p JOIN sky_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id JOIN sky_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
